destination.name: operator-paging-gateway
destination.failure_domain: external-managed-incident-service, independent of native k3s, Flux, DNS, and Longhorn

lanes.name: ticket-dashboard
lanes.purpose: diagnostic, ticket context, and dashboard evidence

lanes.name: page
excludes: individual low-level component failure without customer-impact gate
lanes.purpose: actionable incident creation only after persistence and impact gates

lanes.name: page-recovery
events: recovery of a page-lane Flux object
lanes.purpose: resolve or update the matching incident; do not open a new incident

inhibition: page-recovery suppresses a matching page notification and resolves its incident
a parent service/page identity suppresses duplicate child component pages while the parent is active
deployment diagnostic events never suppress or create page incidents
approved maintenance suppresses page delivery but remains visible in diagnostics
policy.recovery: same identity and routing class as the firing event; receiver must resolve rather than create
policy.low_level_gate: no page from a single HelmRelease, Pod, PVC, or controller error unless an approved SLO, routing, storage, or parent-Kustomization impact gate is also true

verification.diagnostic_event: harmless non-paging reconciliation event in an approved window

native_signals: Provider Ready condition and Kubernetes warning events
failure_observability.independent_signal_required: external monitor of the gateway and a periodic diagnostic delivery, because a failed notification path cannot page through itself
